label: force: the dead store on the V.90 arm is dropped
find: allow[5] = 1;			/* dead -- see the note above */
why: `sel` is set to the session object on that arm and `allow` is never read again, so nothing can observe the store.  It is reproduced because the object performs it, not because it does anything; D49 records it.  A mutation of it being CAUGHT would mean the arm's `sel` had moved.
